ixu-page-1.webp.zh: 奥兰加巴德机场航站楼外景：白色弧顶下是落客车道与出发层入口。
ixu-page-1.webp.en: The terminal forecourt — a white barrel-vaulted roof over the drop-off lane and departures entrance.

ixu-page-2.webp.zh: 从草坪望向航站楼：弧形屋面沿立面展开，塔台在右侧远处。
ixu-page-2.webp.en: The terminal from the lawn — the curved roof running along the frontage, with the control tower far to the right.

ixu-page-3.webp.zh: 出发层入口：雨棚上写着「WELCOME TO CHHATRAPATI SAMBHAJINAGAR AIRPORT」与「प्रस्थान DEPARTURE」。
ixu-page-3.webp.en: The departures entrance — the canopy lettered 'WELCOME TO CHHATRAPATI SAMBHAJINAGAR AIRPORT' and 'प्रस्थान DEPARTURE'.
